szoveg_eredeti:
The future is custom models for maximum performance, cost and ownership thanks to open-source!

Last week, we released Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted (that became second most trending on HF) and a bunch of harness-adapted models that drastically improve performance and cost. 

This week, we're releasing the fully reusable recipe, so you can reproduce this on your own task, harness, and model combinations.

Blogpost: https://huggingface.co/blog/harness-adapters-at-scale

Let's go open-source AI!
